answer: Each identity claim is bound to a fresh VDF challenge and must complete T dependent modular squarings before its Wesolowski proof can be verified. Since each square depends on the previous result, GPUs cannot parallelize a single chain to remove its delay. Lotus, raven, and sparrow clones can run separate chains concurrently only with additional hardware and energy, so Sybil creation retains a per-identity time and resource cost—not an absolute ban on parallel machines.
